newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ibiden rises on back of earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: Ibiden rises on back of earnings forecast.

text.p: Shares in Ibiden Co Ltd rose in Tuesday morning trade on the back of a firm earnings forecast, brokers said.
As of 0153 GMT, the shares were 40 yen higher at 1,120 yen, ranking 17th on the list of top percentage gainers among first-section shares on the Tokyo bourse.
"It's being bought as a part of the quest for firms that are doing well," a second-tier brokerage broker said.
The manufacturer of printed circuit boards earlier forecast a parent current profit of 4.60 billion yen for the year ending next March 31 against 2.09 billion last year.
